title: Rioproperty contact
description: A square violet panel in the page margins: a huge yellow capital heading and a lavender sub-head at the left (centred), and at the right an underlined form of capital placeholders, a drop-down with a chevron, a row of tiny yellow-ringed round ticks, a message box and a yellow SEND with an arrow. As it scrolls in the panel settles from a quarter too big (spilling past the edges) into the margins while its content keeps its size; the fields fade in and the tick row and message rise.
notes: the panel uses primary with highlight (heading, ticks, send) and accent (sub-head): best where primary is a strong, dark colour
a plain HTML form (action + method post); no JavaScript
